skill.summary: Generate social media content (event posters, speaker announcements, partnership posts) using AI synthesis recipes

latestVersion.changelog:
turbo-poster-9000 1.0.0

- Initial release.
- Provides three AI-powered content generation recipes: event posters, speaker announcements, and partnership posts.
- Automatically prompts for required information depending on the chosen recipe.
- Integrates with DeepContent synthesis API for seamless image and text generation.
- Supports both image+caption workflows and text-only partnership announcements.
- User-invocable for easy access by end users.
